goal: Move SolQvia from single-band compatibility into evidence-scoped LTE CA / EN-DC / NR CA combination modeling, while separating standards existence, exact-device capability, carrier deployment and runtime observation.
official_basis: 3GPP TS 36.101 change records for LTE CA combination definitions
3GPP TS 38.101-1 change records for NR CA combinations
3GPP TS 38.101-3 for LTE/NR interworking and EN-DC combinations
Samsung Japan Galaxy S26 SM-S942Q single-band specifications
key_rules: Single-band support never proves a CA/EN-DC/NR CA combination.
A 3GPP-defined combination never proves an exact device supports it.
Exact-device capability never proves carrier deployment.
Carrier deployment never proves runtime use.
Display indicators never prove exact physical-channel composition.
DL aggregation never proves UL CA.
Observed runtime at one place/time never proves nationwide availability.
Every runtime observation should bind to the Phase159 software snapshot when known.

current_device_boundary.action: Keep combinations unknown until exact evidence exists.

next_phase: Phase161 failure-diagnosis engine that consumes Phase154-160 states and asks the minimum next question/test needed to localize a connectivity fault.
